'''Autonomous Walker JS-MW1''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] constructed by [[White Maw]] Overseer [[Droub]]. Following the death of [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]], the White Maw took over the [[Firefrost Lavaworks]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], with Droub becoming the cruel overseer of the factory. The Alliance eventually saw his rise as a threat and dispatched a strike team to Firefost to liberate the slaves and put an end to the production. Droub attempted to stop the intruders with his Walker, but was eventually overwhelmed and killed, while the Walker was destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Autonomous Walker JS-MW1 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as the final boss of the "Firefrost" Uprising.
